events.segmentation.title: Event segmentation
events.segmentation.description: Get Amplitude event segmentation via GET /api/2/events/segmentation.

funnels.get.title: Get funnel
funnels.get.description: Get Amplitude funnel data via GET /api/2/funnels.

annotations.list.title: List annotations
annotations.list.description: List Amplitude chart annotations via GET /api/2/annotations.

annotations.create.title: Create annotation
annotations.create.description: Create an Amplitude chart annotation via POST /api/2/annotations.

annotations.delete.title: Delete annotation
annotations.delete.description: Delete an Amplitude chart annotation via DELETE /api/2/annotations.

taxonomy.events.list.title: List taxonomy events
taxonomy.events.list.description: List Amplitude taxonomy event types via GET /api/2/taxonomy/event.

taxonomy.events.create.title: Create taxonomy event
taxonomy.events.create.description: Create an Amplitude taxonomy event type via POST /api/2/taxonomy/event.

taxonomy.eventProperties.list.title: List event properties
taxonomy.eventProperties.list.description: List Amplitude taxonomy event properties via GET /api/2/taxonomy/event-property.

taxonomy.userProperties.list.title: List user properties
taxonomy.userProperties.list.description: List Amplitude taxonomy user properties via GET /api/2/taxonomy/user-property.

taxonomy.categories.list.title: List event categories
taxonomy.categories.list.description: List Amplitude taxonomy event categories via GET /api/2/taxonomy/category.

cohorts.list.title: List cohorts
cohorts.list.description: List Amplitude behavioral cohorts via GET /api/3/cohorts.

cohorts.get.title: Get cohort
cohorts.get.description: Retrieve an Amplitude behavioral cohort via GET /api/3/cohorts/{cohortId}.

releases.create.title: Create release
releases.create.description: Create an Amplitude release via POST /api/2/release.

usermap.get.title: Get user map
usermap.get.description: Look up Amplitude user mapping via GET /api/2/usermap.

user.description: Amplitude ID, device ID, or user ID.

users.identify.title: Identify user properties
users.identify.description: Update user properties without sending an event via POST https://api2.amplitude.com/identify (form-urlencoded api_key + identification). Covers AMPLITUDE_IDENTIFY. api_key is the connected API key ID. Live Identify bodies are plaintext 'success'; curated recipes require JSON, so fixtures use a JSON envelope.

identification.description: JSON identification object or JSON array of identifications, as Amplitude documents for the Identify API.

events.send.title: Send events (HTTP V2)
events.send.description: Send events via POST https://api2.amplitude.com/2/httpapi. Covers AMPLITUDE_SEND_EVENTS. api_key is the connected API key ID.

events.description: Events to upload. One of user_id or device_id is required, and event_type is required.

options.description: Optional Amplitude upload options such as min_id_length.

events.batch.title: Upload batch events
events.batch.description: Send a larger event batch via POST https://api2.amplitude.com/batch. Covers AMPLITUDE_UPLOAD_BATCH_EVENTS. Same JSON body as HTTP V2; api_key is the connected API key ID.

events.description: Events to upload. One of user_id or device_id is required, and event_type is required.

options.description: Optional Amplitude upload options such as min_id_length.

annotationCategories.list.title: List annotation categories
annotationCategories.list.description: List chart annotation categories via GET /api/3/annotation-categories. Covers AMPLITUDE_LIST_ANNOTATION_CATEGORIES.

annotationCategories.get.title: Get annotation category
annotationCategories.get.description: Get one annotation category via GET /api/3/annotation-categories/{categoryId}. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_ANNOTATION_CATEGORY.

annotationCategories.create.title: Create annotation category
annotationCategories.create.description: Create an annotation category via POST /api/3/annotation-categories. Covers AMPLITUDE_CREATE_ANNOTATION_CATEGORY.

annotationCategories.update.title: Update annotation category
annotationCategories.update.description: Rename an annotation category via PUT /api/3/annotation-categories/{categoryId}. Covers AMPLITUDE_UPDATE_ANNOTATION_CATEGORY.

annotationCategories.delete.title: Delete annotation category
annotationCategories.delete.description: Delete an annotation category via DELETE /api/3/annotation-categories/{categoryId}. Covers AMPLITUDE_DELETE_ANNOTATION_CATEGORY.

annotationCategories.assign.title: Assign annotations to category
annotationCategories.assign.description: Bulk-assign annotations to a category via PUT /api/3/annotation-categories/bulk/{categoryId}. Covers AMPLITUDE_ASSIGN_ANNOTATIONS_TO_CATEGORY.

annotations.get.title: Get annotation
annotations.get.description: Get one chart annotation via GET /api/3/annotations/{annotationId}. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_ANNOTATION.

annotations.update.title: Update annotation
annotations.update.description: Update a chart annotation via PUT /api/3/annotations/{annotationId}. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Covers AMPLITUDE_UPDATE_ANNOTATION.

chartId.description: Chart ID. Omit for no change.

taxonomy.categories.create.title: Create event category
taxonomy.categories.create.description: Create a taxonomy event category via POST /api/2/taxonomy/category (form). Covers AMPLITUDE_CREATE_EVENT_CATEGORY.

taxonomy.categories.update.title: Update event category
taxonomy.categories.update.description: Rename a taxonomy event category via PUT /api/2/taxonomy/category/{categoryId} (form). Covers AMPLITUDE_UPDATE_EVENT_CATEGORY.

taxonomy.categories.delete.title: Delete event category
taxonomy.categories.delete.description: Delete a taxonomy event category via DELETE /api/2/taxonomy/category/{categoryId}. Covers AMPLITUDE_DELETE_EVENT_CATEGORY.

taxonomy.events.get.title: Get event type
taxonomy.events.get.description: Get one taxonomy event type via GET /api/2/taxonomy/event/{eventType}. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_EVENT_TYPE.

taxonomy.events.update.title: Update event type
taxonomy.events.update.description: Update a taxonomy event type via PUT /api/2/taxonomy/event/{eventType} (form). Covers AMPLITUDE_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE.

isActive.description: Whether the event type is active.

taxonomy.events.delete.title: Delete event type
taxonomy.events.delete.description: Delete a taxonomy event type via DELETE /api/2/taxonomy/event/{eventType}. Covers AMPLITUDE_DELETE_EVENT_TYPE.

taxonomy.events.restore.title: Restore event type
taxonomy.events.restore.description: Restore a deleted taxonomy event type via POST /api/2/taxonomy/event/{eventType}/restore. Covers AMPLITUDE_RESTORE_EVENT_TYPE.

taxonomy.eventProperties.get.title: Get event property
taxonomy.eventProperties.get.description: Get one taxonomy event property via GET /api/2/taxonomy/event-property. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_EVENT_PROPERTY.

eventType.description: Optional event type the property belongs to.

taxonomy.userProperties.get.title: Get user property
taxonomy.userProperties.get.description: Get one taxonomy user property via GET /api/2/taxonomy/user-property/{userProperty}. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_USER_PROPERTY. Prefix custom properties with gp:.

users.active.title: Get active or new users
users.active.description: Active or new user counts via GET /api/2/users. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_ACTIVE_USERS.

metric.description: active or new. Defaults to active when omitted.

users.realtime.title: Get realtime active users
users.realtime.description: Realtime active users via GET /api/2/realtime. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_REALTIME_ACTIVE_USERS. Interval is minutes; Amplitude accepts 5.

interval.description: Interval in minutes. Amplitude realtime supports 5.

revenue.ltv.title: Get revenue LTV
revenue.ltv.description: Revenue lifetime value via GET /api/2/revenue/ltv. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_REVENUE_LTV.

sessions.average.title: Get average session length
sessions.average.description: Average session length in seconds via GET /api/2/sessions/average. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_SESSION_AVERAGE.

sessions.length.title: Get session length distribution
sessions.length.description: Session length distribution via GET /api/2/sessions/length. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_SESSION_LENGTH.

sessions.perUser.title: Get sessions per user
sessions.perUser.description: Average sessions per user via GET /api/2/sessions/peruser. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_SESSIONS_PER_USER.

users.composition.title: Get user composition
users.composition.description: User composition for a property via GET /api/2/composition. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_USER_COMPOSITION.

deletions.list.title: Get deletion requests
deletions.list.description: List user deletion jobs via GET /api/2/deletions/users. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_DELETION_REQUESTS.

deletions.create.title: Delete users
deletions.create.description: Submit a user deletion job via POST /api/2/deletions/users. Covers AMPLITUDE_DELETE_USERS. Provide amplitudeIds, userIds, or both.

requester.description: Email of the person requesting deletion.

ignoreInvalidId.description: When true, unknown IDs are reported instead of failing the job.

deleteFromOrg.description: When true, delete across the organization.

includeMappedUserIds.description: When true, include user IDs mapped from amplitude IDs.

deletions.cancel.title: Cancel user deletion
deletions.cancel.description: Remove an Amplitude ID from a staging deletion job via DELETE /api/2/deletions/users/{amplitudeId}/{jobStartDay}. Covers AMPLITUDE_CANCEL_DELETION.

amplitudeId.description: Amplitude ID to remove from the job.

cohorts.request.title: Request cohort export
cohorts.request.description: Start a cohort download via GET /api/5/cohorts/request/{cohortId}. Covers AMPLITUDE_GET_COHORT. Returns a request id to poll.

props.description: Set to 1 to include user properties.

propKeys.description: User properties to include when props is 1.

cohorts.status.title: Check cohort export status
cohorts.status.description: Poll a cohort export via GET /api/5/cohorts/request-status/{requestId}. Covers AMPLITUDE_CHECK_COHORT_STATUS.

requestId.description: Request ID from the cohort export request.

cohorts.download.title: Download cohort file
cohorts.download.description: Download a finished cohort export via GET /api/5/cohorts/request/{requestId}/file. Covers AMPLITUDE_DOWNLOAD_COHORT_FILE. Small exports return a JSON body. Large exports 302 to a one-minute S3 URL; this operation does not follow that redirect.

requestId.description: Request ID from the cohort export request.

cohorts.upload.title: Upload cohort
cohorts.upload.description: Create or replace a cohort via POST /api/3/cohorts/upload. Covers AMPLITUDE_UPLOAD_COHORT.

existingCohortId.description: Existing cohort ID whose membership is replaced.

cohorts.membership.title: Update cohort membership
cohorts.membership.description: Add or remove cohort members via POST /api/3/cohorts/membership. Covers AMPLITUDE_UPDATE_COHORT_MEMBERSHIP. Each membership uses ids, id_type (BY_ID or BY_NAME), and operation (ADD or REMOVE).

countGroup.description: Count group. Defaults to User when omitted.

usermap.create.title: Map user
usermap.create.description: Map or unmap user IDs via POST https://api.amplitude.com/usermap. Covers AMPLITUDE_MAP_USER. mapping is the JSON object or array Amplitude documents. api_key is the connected API key ID.

mapping.description: JSON mapping object or array of mappings.

groups.identify.title: Set group properties
groups.identify.description: Set group properties without an event via POST https://api2.amplitude.com/groupidentify (form). Covers AMPLITUDE_SET_GROUP_PROPERTIES. api_key is the connected API key ID.

identification.description: JSON group identification object or array.

webhook.event.title: Event webhook
webhook.event.description: Inbound Amplitude event-streaming webhook. EventOnly; no runner handler.

webhook.cohort.title: Cohort webhook
webhook.cohort.description: Inbound Amplitude cohort webhook. EventOnly; no runner handler.
